processSampleRpc.command:
(
wv_ps_read() {
  printf 'WVMPS %s\n' "$1"
  if { while IFS= read -r wv_ps_line || [ -n "$wv_ps_line" ]; do printf '%s\n' "$wv_ps_line"; done; } < "$2" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf 'WVMPS_END 0\n'
  else printf 'WVMPS_END 1\n'; fi
}
wv_ps_read 'boot-before' '/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id'
wv_ps_read 'uptime-before' '/proc/uptime'
printf 'WVMPS clock-ticks\n'; getconf CLK_TCK; wv_ps_status=$?; printf 'WVMPS_END %s\n' "$wv_ps_status"
wv_ps_read 'leader-417-before' '/proc/417/stat'
wv_ps_read 'task-417-417-stat-before' '/proc/417/task/417/stat'
wv_ps_read 'task-417-417-schedstat' '/proc/417/task/417/schedstat'
wv_ps_read 'task-417-417-wchan' '/proc/417/task/417/wchan'
wv_ps_read 'task-417-417-stat-after' '/proc/417/task/417/stat'
wv_ps_read 'task-417-462-stat-before' '/proc/417/task/462/stat'
wv_ps_read 'task-417-462-schedstat' '/proc/417/task/462/schedstat'
wv_ps_read 'task-417-462-wchan' '/proc/417/task/462/wchan'
wv_ps_read 'task-417-462-stat-after' '/proc/417/task/462/stat'
wv_ps_read 'leader-417-after' '/proc/417/stat'
wv_ps_read 'leader-503-before' '/proc/503/stat'
wv_ps_read 'task-503-503-stat-before' '/proc/503/task/503/stat'
wv_ps_read 'task-503-503-schedstat' '/proc/503/task/503/schedstat'
wv_ps_read 'task-503-503-wchan' '/proc/503/task/503/wchan'
wv_ps_read 'task-503-503-stat-after' '/proc/503/task/503/stat'
wv_ps_read 'leader-503-after' '/proc/503/stat'
wv_ps_read 'leader-504-before' '/proc/504/stat'
wv_ps_read 'task-504-504-stat-before' '/proc/504/task/504/stat'
wv_ps_read 'task-504-504-schedstat' '/proc/504/task/504/schedstat'
wv_ps_read 'task-504-504-wchan' '/proc/504/task/504/wchan'
wv_ps_read 'task-504-504-stat-after' '/proc/504/task/504/stat'
wv_ps_read 'leader-504-after' '/proc/504/stat'
wv_ps_read 'uptime-after' '/proc/uptime'
wv_ps_read 'boot-after' '/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id'
)
